title: Clipboard widget settings don't have an About page
line: The Clipboard settings now have an About page, like every other widget's settings.
explanation: The Clipboard widget's settings are Klipper's own old KConfigDialog rather than the standard Plasma widget configuration, so they never got the automatic About page other widgets show. The change adds an About page to that dialog, filled from the clipboard applet's metadata: icon, name, description, version, website, a Report an issue link, license and authors.

commits.message:
klipper: add an About page to the Clipboard settings

The Clipboard settings use their own dialog instead of the standard
widget one, so they never got the About page every other widget has. Add
one built from the applet's metadata, with version, website and authors.

BUG: 523828

media.caption: Clipboard settings on master: General, Actions, Action Menu and Shortcuts, no About page
With the fix: a new About page showing the applet's name, description, version, website, bug report link, license and author
